Report

Where drafts are stored

Drafts are written to one SQLite database by the store, which the editor reads at start.

Decided 2026-10-09: drafts are stored in SQLite

The reviewer chose SQLite over JSON files: one file, transactions.

Design

The editor reads drafts from the store at start. The sync job reads drafts from the store too.

Changed 2026-10-09 (see the decision): the store keeps drafts in one SQLite database and writes each draft on save.

The store kept drafts in JSON files, one per draft, and wrote each draft to one of them on save.
